description: This script manages crash dump uploads, including locking, logging, file handling, archiving, and uploading dumps to a crash portal. It also initializes environment variables and handles cleanup.

methods.name: exit_impl
methods.description: Exits the script with a given status code.

methods.name: log_info
methods.description: Logs informational messages with process ID and timestamp.

methods.name: log_error
methods.description: Logs error messages with process ID and timestamp.

methods.name: log_fatal
methods.description: Logs a fatal error and exits with code 255.

methods.name: log_std_out
methods.description: Reads lines from stdin and logs each line.

methods.name: at_exit
methods.description: Handles cleanup on script exit, logs failure if needed.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Removes lock directory and resets traps.

methods.name: try_lock
methods.description: Creates a lock directory to prevent concurrent runs.

methods.name: get_last_modified_time_of_file
methods.description: Returns the last modified time of a file in a specific format.

methods.name: is_file_size_changing
methods.description: Checks if a file's size is changing over a short period.

methods.name: ud_initialize
methods.description: Initializes environment variables and configuration based on input parameters.

methods.name: ud_compose_filename
methods.description: Generates a filename based on dump metadata.

methods.name: ud_get_file_timestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the last modified timestamp of a file.

methods.name: ud_check_log_file
methods.description: Ensures log directory and file exist and are writable.

methods.name: ud_set_mac_address
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve and set the MAC address.

methods.name: ud_set_sha1_sum
methods.description: Calculates and sets the SHA1 checksum of the receiver file.

methods.name: ud_set_model_num
methods.description: Extracts and sets the device model number from version.txt.

methods.name: ud_backup_dump_file_if_needed
methods.description: Backs up dump file if required.

methods.name: ud_create_dump_archive
methods.description: Creates a compressed archive of dump files and logs.

methods.name: ud_upload_dump_archive
methods.description: Uploads the dump archive to the crash portal via SCP.

methods.name: ud_cleanup
methods.description: Removes dump archive and dump files.

methods.name: ud_set_dump_file
methods.description: Sets the dump file path and timestamp if the file is stable.

methods.name: ud_upload_dumps
methods.description: Main function to process and upload dump files from the working directory.
